shared_testcase_rationale: PR #26 supplies the pinned manifest and model inputs. This receipt locks the revised journey digest, manifest v3, fork SHA, app SHA, and APK digest to both lanes; it does not infer X99 applicability from the Pixel PR title.

lanes.fixture_reset: Fresh fixture before every positive or negative attempt; force-stop, clear app data, cold-start, and secure-storage readiness check.
assertions: The recovery snapshot confirms the account, USD balance, History gap, and Recovery adjustment before relaunch.
A recorded successful post-save force-stop and process-end check precede relaunch.
The relaunch reaches the Recovery snapshot.
The account and USD balance equal the unique attempt values byte-for-byte.

relaunch_proof.after_save_stop: Record a successful stop_app or am force-stop after UI save and before relaunch.
relaunch_proof.process_ended: Record a process check showing the saved process ended before relaunch.

required_evidence: Recovery snapshot confirmation for the original account and USD balance
recorded post-save process stop and verified process end
relaunch evidence for the Recovery snapshot
recorded mismatch between the observed account name and qual-<run_id>-WRONG-SUFFIX

lanes.cleanup_contract: After every outcome, restore and confirm the cold fixture before the executor releases its claim; record verified release or leave the target unavailable with a recovery owner.
